annotations.title: Non-KYC Cross-Chain Bridge Route & Settlement Fee Comparator

description: Compares non-custodial, non-KYC cross-chain swap routes (THORChain native L1 swaps, Maya Protocol, Blockstream Liquid) by basis-point fee, net output sats, and settlement time. Use when routing cross-chain treasury settlements (e.g. Solana USDC or Base ETH into native Bitcoin); for calculating mid-market spot exchange rates without bridge routing fees, use calculate_spot_swap_rate instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'from_asset' ('to_asset' defaults to 'BTC_NATIVE'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

amount.description: Input asset amount to quote; defaults to 100.0 when omitted.

from_asset.description: Origin chain asset identifier to bridge from.

to_asset.description: Destination chain asset identifier; defaults to 'BTC_NATIVE' when omitted.

name: compare_crosschain_bridge_routes

estimated_output_sats.description: Net settled output denominated in Bitcoin satoshis.

fee_bps.description: Total protocol and slip fee in basis points.

kyc_required.description: Always false; only non-custodial permissionless routes are returned.

title: Non-KYC Cross-Chain Bridge Route & Settlement Fee Comparator
